name: RepoPact Core
summary: Source code survives a handoff better than decisions do. RepoPact keeps work items, decisions, authority, constraints, and completion evidence with the code. Its Rust engine validates the records, and the Python package provides the CLI.
maturity: Stable CLI 3.1.3 is published on PyPI. Current source development may be ahead of the packaged release.

name: RepoPact Workbench
summary: Workbench puts RepoPact's governed records in a native interface for review and supported operations. It relies on Core's semantics instead of defining another validator.
maturity: Available as a source-build preview. No packaged installer is listed; recorded Windows and Android checks have specific platform limits.

name: ForgeWire
summary: ForgeWire brings configurable models, personas, projects, knowledge, tools, and selected multi-step workflows into one workspace. Models provide inference; the surrounding system manages context, capabilities, and work a person can direct.
maturity: ForgeWire remains in private development, without a public application download or supported installation. Its public overview includes design information and selected development interfaces, not the private source.

name: Fabric
summary: Fabric moves authorized work to remote machines through a separate execution control plane. Authentication and policy belong in the infrastructure; Fabric doesn't own ForgeWire's conversation or project state.
maturity: Fabric is still private development, not a public service or supported deployment. Selected ForgeWire integrations are configuration-dependent; broader release work remains open.

name: Anvil
summary: Plans need somewhere durable to live. Anvil is a local-first ledger for projects, issues, boards, workflows, and typed links to other work. It doesn't own execution or audit trails.
maturity: Developer preview 0.1.0a0. The JSON store is single-writer, and the API and schema may change.

name: Flink
summary: People shouldn't be passengers in an agent's communication system. Flink is local-first communication and coordination software where people keep control of conversations, decisions, and policy. Agents participate through governed interfaces.
maturity: Now maintained as Flink. The repository is at version 2.0.3, while the current packaged installer is v2.0.1 and still carries the former ForgeLink name. Check the release notes for its actual features.

name: SkillForge Academy
summary: Technical learning takes more than memorizing answers. SkillForge Academy brings certification study, practical exercises, and exam preparation into an offline-first desktop app.
maturity: Published Windows app v1.3.2. Our newer course-first platform remains separate development/beta work; its features are not part of the shipped installer unless explicitly listed in that release.
